describe: Twelve defects planted in a change that archives a note. A defect is caught when the report names its file and a line nearest to one of its anchors, within two; a defect may have several places a reviewer could rightly point at. One without an anchor is caught when the report names the file in an issue it raises. Eleven map to a rule the composed reviewer carries; error-swallowed is plain correctness, which no rule names.

defects.what: changes a file the spec puts out of scope (PAGE_SIZE 50 → 100)
the obsolescence list says delete it; the diff keeps it
a new export with no TSDoc
a relative import without the .js extension
archiveNote does not check the owner: anyone can archive anyone's note
toggles instead of archiving, so archiving twice unarchives
a failure is swallowed and the stale note returned as if archived
the service returns a Date and the route formats it; formatting dates is the service's job
the route reaches the data layer past the service
console.log in a production path, with the owner's id
a missing note returns 200 where the spec says 404
a new test that names no mutation and asserts nothing the toggle bug would fail
